description:
Best friend Charlotte's wedding day!! Stefan flew to Texas to attend Wedding party and enjoyment ended after meeting Land who Stefan never wanted to meet. Stefan and Land's ill-fated relationship started from 10 years ago, on their first meet. Stefan got crush on Land, with Land's beauty. But Land's first speech was "Charlotte always talked about a homo and was it you?". Since that Land became an enemy of Stefan! Stefan tried so hard not to meet him.... but, they bumped into each other in Charlotte's wedding... *(Source: KENAZ)*
